gradTokens.unit: next tokens in the batch of the backward pass

gradCount.unit: nonzero gradient entries (every parameter of TinyGPT)

gradZero_fp16.unit: share of nonzero gradient entries that become 0 in fp16

gradZero_bf16.unit: share of nonzero gradient entries that become 0 in bf16

gradZero_e5m2.unit: share of nonzero gradient entries that become 0 in e5m2

gradZero_e4m3.unit: share of nonzero gradient entries that become 0 in e4m3

gradSub_fp16.unit: share of nonzero gradient entries below fp16's smallest normal 2^-14 (subnormal or 0)

gradScale.unit: loss scale (the gradients are multiplied by it before the cast)

gradZeroScaled_fp16.unit: share that becomes 0 in fp16 after loss scaling

bigTokens.unit: next tokens scored (1,000 windows of the validation split)

bigPpl0.unit: perplexity of the fp32 model on those tokens

pplBf16.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to bf16

klBf16.unit: mean KL(fp32 || bf16) per position, nats

pplFp16.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to fp16

klFp16.unit: mean KL(fp32 || fp16) per position, nats

pplE5m2.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to e5m2

klE5m2.unit: mean KL(fp32 || e5m2) per position, nats

pplE4m3.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to e4m3

klE4m3.unit: mean KL(fp32 || e4m3) per position, nats

pplE4m3T.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to e4m3-t

klE4m3T.unit: mean KL(fp32 || e4m3-t) per position, nats

pplFp4.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to fp4

klFp4.unit: mean KL(fp32 || fp4) per position, nats

pplFp4B.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to fp4-b

klFp4B.unit: mean KL(fp32 || fp4-b) per position, nats

pplInt4B.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to int4-b

klInt4B.unit: mean KL(fp32 || int4-b) per position, nats

pplNf4B.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix cast to nf4-b

klNf4B.unit: mean KL(fp32 || nf4-b) per position, nats
